advantages.description: Precision-engineered to support your business scalability from dozens to thousands of daily transactions.

sync.title: Instant Multi-Branch Synchronization
sync.description: All cashier sales transactions, warehouse inventory transfers, and inter-branch financial reconciliations connect seamlessly in real-time.

security.title: Data Security & Role Permissions
security.description: Protection of transaction data and employee privacy with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), 256-bit encryption, and comprehensive audit logs.

uptime.title: High-Availability Cloud Infrastructure
uptime.description: Modern cloud architecture with adaptive load balancing, peak-hour auto-scaling, and a 99.9% uptime SLA for seamless 24/7 operations.

support.title: Dedicated Central Java Tech Support
support.description: Direct support from Mitrasova engineers in Karanganyar & Solo Raya. We assist with system auditing, rollout, staff onboarding, and custom engineering.

workflow.title: How We Transform Your
workflow.description: Four transparent, measurable implementation phases ensuring a seamless transition without disrupting daily business operations.

step1.title: Audit & Requirements Consultation
step1.description: We analyze your cashier workflows, HR attendance & payroll rules, or custom software architecture requirements tailored to your business scale.

step2.title: System Customization & Integration
step2.description: Setting up centralized databases, testing thermal printer/barcode hardware, configuring shift matrices, and user role permission access.

step3.title: Data Migration & Staff Training
step3.description: Secure migration of product catalogs, price lists, and employee profiles, accompanied by interactive training sessions until staff proficiency.

step4.title: Production Launch & 24/7 SLA
step4.description: System officially goes live to process your business transactions. Backed by proactive server monitoring, daily backups, and responsive engineering support.
